native_refresh.procedure: Profile.update fetches subscription bytes, validates through the core, writes the same profile file, returns metadata with current lastUpdateDate. AppController.updateProfile stores returned metadata and reapplies the profile when it is current.

persistence.config: Config serialized as JSON string by SharedPreferences under config key; actual platform file shape must be preserved.
persistence.initialization: GlobalState reads preferences at app startup. Core initialization reapplies current profile from disk and selectedMap.
persistence.live_edit_risk: App provider changes schedule a preferences save after 3 seconds. External edits while the app is running can be overwritten by its in-memory config.

unsafe_guessed_ipc.fact: The app loopback TCP listener is the CoreService channel that accepts a core connection. Connecting another socket calls _destroySocket before replacing it, detaching the current core. It is not an app HTTP refresh endpoint.
unsafe_guessed_ipc.standalone_core_cli: FlClashCore accepts one app socket endpoint argument. It has no standard Mihomo -v/-t/-f CLI; passing -v is interpreted as a Unix socket path.

relaunch.windows_listener_start: Desktop startTime is new/null; _initStatus takes appSetting.autoRun. With autoRun=false, relaunch loads/applies the new config but stops listeners until native start is invoked.
relaunch.helper: Helper /start hash-validates the core binary, stops the prior owned child, and launches the core with the new app socket port. Native app performs this; no direct SYSTEM child termination is needed.
start_actions: Existing user-configured global hotKeyActions entry with action=start

deep_link.behavior: Displays confirmation, then adds a new subscription profile. It is not a silent refresh or start action; an existing current profile remains selected.
